title: MembershipShape
description: Schema for Membership entities following Open Pulse Ontology v2.1.2. Optimized for LLM agent parsing with descriptive guidance. ID hierarchy: composite (personId_orgId) → uuid. SHACL requires: org:organization only. Role and dates are optional.

id.description: Resolved hierarchical identifier. Composite format: personId_orgId, or uuid (fallback). Example: '0000-0001-2345-6789_https://ror.org/02s376052'

identifiers.description: All available identifiers for this membership. Contains pulse:composite and uuid

pulse:composite.description: Composite identifier. Format: personId_orgId (uses underscore separator). Example: '0000-0001-2345-6789_https://ror.org/02s376052'

uuid.description: UUID4 fallback identifier. Always present. Example: 'c1a2b3c4-5d6e-4f7a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c'

idSource.description: Indicates which identifier was used as the primary 'id'. One of: 'pulse:composite' or 'uuid'

org:organization.description: Reference to OrganizationShape ID (hierarchical). REQUIRED per SHACL. Example: 'https://ror.org/02s376052'

org:role.description: Role or position title within the organization. OPTIONAL per SHACL. Example: 'Research Engineer', 'PhD Student'

time:hasBeginning.description: Start date of membership. Format: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: '2020-09-01'

time:hasEnd.description: End date of membership. Format: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Null if current/ongoing. Example: '2024-02-28'
